#192 fix r4.summary:
Round 4 for #192: both review items are fixed. I amended the commit in /tmp/wt-192, so the branch is still one commit: fb7fce29 on dfb4ddcc, not rebased and not pushed. Main moved to 8428e16c during the run and I left it alone.

Item 1 (blocking): the relaxed-session note no longer runs past the TUI's 200-character line. I reproduced the overflow on 0626a6ba first. api.business.githubcopilot.com with code 89 gave a 211-character line, api.openai.com with 88 gave 204, and us-central1-aiplatform.googleapis.com with 85 gave 202, and the TUI cut all three. The fix is a new Relaxation.remedy() in providers/_tls_strict.py, which _strict_hint now returns. The note is now four parts: a fixed opening line, the host on its own line, the failed check on its own line, and the line saying verification is still enforced and the cause is not certificate strictness. A host longer than 192 characters continues on the next line instead of being cut. describe() is unchanged, so aelix status still prints the same single line as on dfb4ddcc.

The note now shows whole for a host of up to 576 characters (DNS allows 253) and a verify message of up to 187. The longest OpenSSL 3.6.4 message is 68 characters. That exact condition is now stated in ADR-0241 (paragraph and index row), the CHANGELOG, the _error_hints module docstring and remedy()'s docstring, and a test pins it. The TLS guide and its bundled copy now quote the note exactly as the product prints it.

The fits-the-TUI test now checks the note for 5 hosts (up to the 253-character DNS maximum) against 19 messages, on both trust stores: 190 rows. Each row also checks that the host, the message and the still-enforced line are on screen. Against 0626a6ba's code the new tests fail: 147 failed, 117 passed.

I also ran the real TUI on Python 3.13.13 at 220 and 100 columns, against a local server failing on code 89 for a 201-character host. The note showed whole and the retries reached the server, so the relaxation took effect.

Item 2: both mutants that survived round 3 now fail tests. Dropping the still-enforced sentence from the note fails 190 rows. Making describe() two lines fails a new test that pins its dfb4ddcc text. In a sabotage run, 28 of 29 mutants failed. The one survivor, 79 in the allowlist, changes nothing because the 79 check runs first.

The whole suite passes on 3.12.13. Details and commands are in /Users/handochan/dev/aelix-ai/.omc/probes/192-live/r4/KIT.txt.

nonblocking.title: The fits test's 'message on screen' check is satisfied by the error line, not the note
nonblocking.detail: In test_every_tls_remedy_fits_the_tui_error_bound, each relaxed row builds the later error with _real_shape(code, message), so the relaxation's verify message is already in the error line. The check that the message is on screen therefore passes even when the note leaves it out. The commit message says each row 'also asserts the message is on screen', which is literally true, but that assertion does not test the '  failed on: ' line. Tightening it, for example by asserting '  failed on: ' + message as a line of what is shown, would make the check direct. The mutant is still caught, so this does not block.
